security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI writes menvcfg.PBMTE or menvcfg.ADUE during cold boot or domain context switch without subsequently executing SFENCE.VMA with rs1=x0 and rs2=x0 before any S-mode address translation occurs
security_spec.summary: Missing SFENCE.VMA after menvcfg.PBMTE/ADUE write leaves stale address-translation cache entries, allowing S-mode to use page-table PBMT/A/D interpretations inconsistent with M-mode firmware intent, potentially granting write access to read-only regions or enabling cacheable access to device I/O
